SmolDataEnvs

FineEnvs/SmolDataEnvs

Answer a question about a real Kaggle table; each row holds the data, question and gold answer, with a bundled grader.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • hill-climbing small models
  • plain load-and-go RL data

Reward

How it is scored
Exact match
Signal
Pass or fail

grader.py scores the answer by exact match, numeric tolerance, list and percent normalisation, then symbolic equivalence.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

ds = load_dataset("FineEnvs/SmolDataEnvs", split="eval_verified")

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download FineEnvs/SmolDataEnvs --repo-type dataset --local-dir SmolDataEnvs

Evidence

eval_verified and test_verified subsets had gold answers reproduced by an independent solver.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
